concepts.quote: i is the total so far
concepts.why: i is the loop index used to reach each a[i], not a running total, so the answer confuses the index with a stored or summed value.
The answer says nothing about statements or the order in which they run.

concepts.quote: i is the total so far and max counts the elements
concepts.why: The answer gives accumulator and counter roles to variables that are really an index and a running maximum, and no variable here sums or counts.
